A LITTLE PREPARATION MAKES SPACE FOR REST

The last stretch
is on foot.

This is a remote village stay. Allow around an hour for the walk and confirm the exact roadhead, meeting point and route before travelling. Timing varies with route, weather and pace.

01

01 · Roadhead

Ask the hosts to confirm the approach to Faldakot Malla and onward travel from Rishikesh for your arrival date.

02

02 · Trail & village

Wear shoes with grip, pack lightly and plan to arrive in daylight. Confirm luggage support if you need it.

03

03 · Hemp house

Bring essentials before leaving town: shops nearby are limited. Settle into the quieter pace of village life.

Good to know before booking.

Walking access & mobility

Access requires a mountain walk. Discuss terrain, steps, mobility needs and luggage with the hosts before booking; do not assume vehicle access to the house.

Weather & what to pack

Check the forecast shortly before travel. Bring layers, walking shoes, rain protection, a torch and your everyday essentials. Ask about trail conditions during rain.

Medical needs & emergency access

Discuss any access requirements and the nearest available medical services with the hosts. Bring personal medicines and confirm an emergency transport plan before arrival.

Connectivity, meals & facilities

Confirm mobile coverage, Wi-Fi, power availability, hot water, dietary needs and meal arrangements for your dates, especially if planning to work remotely.

House rules & cancellations

Respect quiet hours, neighbours and shared spaces. Alcohol consumption, loud music and disruptive noise are not permitted. Please honour the quiet rhythm and traditions of our village. Confirm other house policies and cancellation terms before booking.
